messages:
alex: Quick sync on v1->v2 compatibility policy. Ops saw a spike in tickets when small tenants got auto-migrated; looking for a safer rollout pattern.
maya: We should separate billing alerts from migration telemetry. Otherwise CS gets paged for expected deltas.
jon: Technical: router currently does pin -> version-header -> fallback. We want to insert a compat-check step so we can keep some tenants on v1 by policy. New order: pin -> version-header -> compat-check -> fallback.
sara: Console: need an internal badge for "compat-held" tenants, expiry, and a revoke action for CS. Also a tenant-facing banner with migration ETA.
lucy: I'll mock the internal badge and a filter row for the migration dashboard. PM wants copy variants for 30d vs 14d windows.
pm-ryan: PM note: default grace should be 30 days for SMBs, 14 days for larger customers unless they request an escape-hatch. Legal will review notice language.
maya: Telemetry plan: tag compat-held requests with header `X-Redwood-Compat: held` so billing can exclude those tokens from "spike" alerts while telemetry still records them for migration progress. Sample 100% for 72h then 5%.
jon: Router pseudocode snippet: ```if pinned == 'v1' -> route v1
else if header.version == 'v2' -> route v2
else if compat_hold(tenant) -> route v1; inject X-Redwood-Compat: held
else -> route v2```
ops-bot: Ops note: introduce a global `compat_hold_cap` to limit total v1 capacity reserved for held tenants. Default 3% of v1 pool. If exceeded, new holds are rejected.
alex: Quotas: held tenants must get a soft quota cap (rps + tokens/min) to avoid stealing v1 capacity. Surface cap in tenant usage page.
sara: I'll own console revoke API + notification flow to CS. Also add audit log entries for grants/revokes.
lucy: I'll add dashboard rows: held_count, held_tokens_excluded, held_quota_headroom.
deploy-bot: PRs: router change + header injection + telemetry flag + console badge. Staging smoke passed. Canary at 2% tomorrow behind feature flag `compat-hold`.
maya: Alerts: page if v1_util > 65% or billing-delta > 25% in a 24h window. Also alert if held_count > config.max_held.
jon: I'll land the router patch behind the flag. Add cache for tenant-checks to avoid KVS hits.
alex: Runbook: pre-canary baselines, post-canary checks, rollback = turn off flag + revoke outstanding holds. I'll draft and share link.
pm-ryan: please include CS steps for revoke and customer communication.
alex: Thanks — team owners: router=jon, telemetry=maya, console=sara, dashboards=lucy, runbook=alex. Ping when canary is live.
